title: Home Comfort Financing Merchant Refund Application and Payoff Quote Validity
content:
Two plan terms of Home Comfort Financing: how a refund from Harbison is applied to the account, and how long a payoff quote stays valid.

| Plan | How a refund from Harbison is applied to the account | Payoff quote valid for |
|---|---|---|
| 12-Month Same-As-Cash Deferred Interest Plan | applied to the promotional balance as principal; the monthly payment is not recalculated | 10 calendar days |
| 18-Month 0% APR Equal Payment Plan | applied to the promotional balance as principal; the monthly payment is not recalculated | 10 calendar days |
| 36-Month 0% APR Equal Payment Plan | applied to the promotional balance as principal; the monthly payment is not recalculated | 10 calendar days |
| 60-Month 5.99% APR Fixed-Rate Plan | applied to principal; the monthly payment is not recalculated and the term shortens | 10 calendar days |
| 120-Month 7.99% APR Fixed-Rate Plan | applied to principal; the monthly payment is not recalculated and the term shortens | 10 calendar days |
| 144-Month 9.99% APR Fixed-Rate Plan | applied to principal; the monthly payment is not recalculated and the term shortens | 10 calendar days |

On the three promotional plans a refund goes to the promotional balance; on the three fixed-rate plans it goes to principal and the term shortens. On no plan is the monthly payment recalculated after a refund.
